# Divider (`divider`)

Horizontal or vertical rule, optionally labelled.

Group: Foundations. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/foundations';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createButton` (types in `dist/web/actions/button.d.ts`): `.mh-button` with `--primary | --secondary | --tonal | --text | --danger` and `--sm | --lg`; states `.is-loading` and `:disabled`. Height follows the theme's density, corners its control radius.

```ts
export function createButton(options: ButtonOptions): ButtonHandle;

export interface ButtonOptions {
  label: string;
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  trailingIcon?: IconName | string;
  loading?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  type?: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset';
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface ButtonHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  setLabel(label: string): void;
  setLoading(loading: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

`createDivider` (types in `dist/web/foundations/text.d.ts`): `.mh-divider`: a horizontal or vertical rule, optionally labelled.

```ts
export function createDivider(options: DividerOptions = {}): HTMLElement;

export interface DividerOptions {
  vertical?: boolean;
  label?: string;
}
```

`createText` (types in `dist/web/foundations/text.d.ts`): `.mh-text--<variant>`: the type scale at the current device class.

```ts
export function createText(content: Child, options: TextOptions = {}): HTMLElement;

export interface TextOptions {
  variant?: TextVariant;
  tone?: TextTone;
  /** Element to render; default `p`, or `h1`–`h3` for display, headline and title. */
  as?: keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createButton, createDivider, createText } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const pairing = document.createElement('div');
pairing.append(
  createButton({ label: 'Scan the QR code', icon: 'camera', variant: 'primary', fullWidth: true }).el,
  createDivider({ label: 'or' }),
  createText('Enter the pairing code shown on the device.', { tone: 'muted' }),
  createDivider(),
  createButton({ label: 'Cancel', variant: 'text' }).el,
);

document.body.append(pairing);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { Button, Divider, Text } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function DividerExample() {
  return (
    <div>
      <Button icon="camera" variant="primary" fullWidth>
        Scan the QR code
      </Button>
      <Divider label="or" />
      <Text tone="muted">Enter the pairing code shown on the device.</Text>
      <Divider />
      <Button variant="text">Cancel</Button>
    </div>
  );
}
```
